parole.testo: Perhaps from Ancient Greek Ἀρφαξάδ (Arphaxád), from Biblical Hebrew אַרְפַּכְשַׁד (ʾArpaḵšaḏ, “Arpachshad”, name of one of Shem's children), in which case it would be a doublet of Arpacsad.

parole.significato: Nazarite (Jew bound by a particular vow)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Ancient Greek ναζιραῖος (naziraîos), from Biblical Hebrew נָזִיר (nāzîr, “Nazarite”).
